description: Extract specific pages from a PDF. Type page ranges like 1-3, 5, 8-10 and get a new PDF containing exactly those pages, in your order.

faqs.a: Type single pages (5), ranges (1-3) and mix them with commas, e.g. 1-3, 5, 8-10. Pages are extracted in the order you list them.
faqs.q: How do I write the page ranges?

faqs.a: No. Splitting creates a brand-new PDF with only the pages you selected. Your original file is never modified.
faqs.q: Does splitting change my original PDF?

faqs.a: Page 1 is the first page of the document, counting up from there. The tool shows the total page count after you load a file.

howto: Choose a PDF file — its total page count appears once loaded.
Type the pages you want, e.g. 1-3, 5, 8-10.
Click "Extract pages" — invalid ranges show a clear error.
The new PDF with only your chosen pages downloads automatically.
title: PDF Splitter
